description: EMA-smoothed 1-step log return normalized by rolling log-return volatility. Always returns Bull or Bear based on the sign of z. Neutral logic is handled separately by neutral_gate_v1.json.
notes: Directional output is based purely on the sign of z.
Neutral suppression should be applied via neutral_gate_v1.json.
Designed to be composable with EMA/VWAP committee models.
